name: Harness demo on the keytest ROM

steps.post: 🎮 Goobster's GBA harness is live — here's the test cartridge as I found it.
Moved the square down-right with six D-pad presses.
Held A while walking left — the square runs red while A is down.
And load_state puts everything back where we started. Pipe proven end-to-end. 🏁
